name: Oral Prophylaxis (Scaling & Polishing)
description: Professional cleaning to remove plaque, tartar, and stains. Recommended every 6 months.

name: Fluoride Treatment
description: Topical fluoride application to strengthen enamel and prevent caries.

name: Pit & Fissure Sealant (per tooth)
description: Protective resin coating applied to the chewing surfaces of molars and premolars.

name: Composite Filling – 1 Surface
description: Tooth-coloured resin restoration for small to moderate caries.

name: Composite Filling – 2 Surface
description: Two-surface tooth-coloured restoration.

name: Composite Filling – 3 Surface
description: Three-surface composite restoration for larger cavities.

name: GIC (Glass Ionomer) Filling
description: Fluoride-releasing glass ionomer cement restoration; ideal for cervical lesions and pediatric cases.

name: Amalgam Filling (per surface)
description: Silver amalgam restoration, durable for posterior teeth.

name: Root Canal Treatment – Anterior
description: Single-canal endodontic therapy for incisors and canines.

name: Root Canal Treatment – Premolar
description: Endodontic therapy for premolars (1–2 canals).

name: Root Canal Treatment – Molar
description: Multi-visit or single-visit endodontic therapy for molars (3–4 canals).

name: RCT Retreatment
description: Re-treatment of a previously root-canal treated tooth that has failed.

name: Post & Core Build-up
description: Intracanal post with core build-up to support a crown after RCT.

name: Scaling & Root Planing (per quadrant)
description: Deep cleaning below the gum line to treat periodontal disease.

name: Gingivectomy (per quadrant)
description: Surgical removal of excess gum tissue to reduce pocket depth.

name: Gingival Curettage (per quadrant)
description: Removal of diseased soft tissue lining of periodontal pockets.

name: PRF Membrane (platelet-rich fibrin)
description: Biologic membrane prepared from patient's own blood for guided tissue regeneration.

name: PFM Crown (Porcelain Fused to Metal)
description: Metal-based crown with porcelain veneer; strong and aesthetic.

name: Zirconia Crown
description: All-ceramic zirconia crown; superior aesthetics and biocompatibility.

name: e.max (All-Ceramic) Crown
description: Lithium disilicate press ceramic crown for optimal translucency and strength.

name: Removable Partial Denture (per arch)
description: Acrylic or cast-metal partial denture to replace missing teeth.

name: Complete Denture (per arch)
description: Full acrylic or flexible denture for edentulous arch.

name: PFM Bridge – 3 Unit
description: Three-unit porcelain-fused-to-metal fixed bridge.

name: Zirconia Bridge – 3 Unit
description: Three-unit all-zirconia fixed bridge.

name: Dental Implant Placement
description: Titanium implant surgical placement (fixture only, excludes abutment and crown).

name: Implant Crown (Zirconia)
description: Zirconia crown placed over dental implant abutment.

name: Orthodontic Consultation
description: Initial assessment and treatment planning for braces or aligners.

name: Metal Braces (full treatment)
description: Conventional metal bracket-and-wire orthodontic treatment.

name: Ceramic Braces (full treatment)
description: Tooth-coloured ceramic brackets for a more aesthetic alternative to metal braces.

name: Clear Aligners (full treatment)
description: Removable transparent aligner therapy (e.g., Invisalign or local brands).

name: Simple Extraction
description: Extraction of a mobile or non-impacted tooth under local anaesthesia.

name: Surgical Extraction (complicated)
description: Extraction requiring soft-tissue or bone removal; includes suturing.

name: Wisdom Tooth Extraction (impacted)
description: Surgical removal of impacted third molar; difficulty and cost vary by angulation.

name: Alveoloplasty
description: Reshaping of the alveolar ridge post-extraction to improve denture fit.

name: Incision & Drainage of Abscess
description: Surgical drainage of a localised dentoalveolar abscess.

name: In-Office Teeth Whitening
description: Professional chair-side bleaching using hydrogen peroxide gel with light activation.

name: Composite Veneer (per tooth)
description: Directly applied composite resin to improve shape, colour, or minor alignment.

name: Porcelain Veneer (per tooth)
description: Lab-fabricated thin porcelain shell bonded to the labial surface of anterior teeth.

name: Smile Design Consultation
description: Digital smile design planning with photographs and mock-up presentation.

name: Pulpectomy – Primary Tooth
description: Complete removal of pulp tissue from a primary (baby) tooth followed by resorbable obturation.

name: Stainless Steel Crown – Primary Tooth
description: Prefabricated stainless steel crown to restore severely decayed primary molars.

name: Space Maintainer
description: Fixed or removable appliance to preserve arch space after premature primary tooth loss.

name: X-Ray – IOPA (per film)
description: Intraoral periapical radiograph for detailed view of individual teeth and surrounding bone.

name: X-Ray – OPG (Panoramic)
description: Full-jaw panoramic radiograph for comprehensive view of all teeth and bone.

name: Consultation – New Patient
description: Initial clinical examination, treatment planning, and record taking for a new patient.

name: Consultation – Follow-up
description: Review visit to monitor treatment progress or post-operative healing.
